rules_learned: Boost/Bury votes adjust local priority only, not external authority.
Simulation scores prioritize local research only; they do not prove revenue, demand, conversion, or ROI.
ROI must be measured before budget increases.
Finder Fee category scores prioritize local niche research only; they do not prove paying customers.
patterns_to_repeat: Chris Boost votes indicate which opportunity types deserve more local work.
Review-ready items with source-backed evidence can produce local artifacts safely.
High simulation score: idx-web-0006 — Shutterstock to pay $35M over hard-to-cancel subscriptions scored 14. Continue local simulation and prepare stronger packet.
High simulation score: idx-manual-finder-001 — Finder Fee Sourcing Concierge scored 10. Continue local simulation and prepare stronger packet.
Finder Fee category signal: arcade-pinball-parts — Arcade and pinball machine parts scored 9. Stronger niche because it is specific, searchable, and low-risk enough for local match-packet simulation.

Finder Fee category signal: discontinued-appliance-parts — Discontinued appliance replacement parts scored 9. Stronger niche because it is specific, searchable, and low-risk enough for local match-packet simulation.

Finder Fee category signal: industrial-sewing-parts — Industrial sewing machine parts scored 8. Stronger niche because it is specific, searchable, and low-risk enough for local match-packet simulation.
